newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Malian prime minister to visit Morocco.
newsitem.headline: Malian prime minister to visit Morocco.

text.p: Malian Prime Minister Ibrahim Keita will pay a working visit to Morocco starting on Monday, the official news agency MAP said on Saturday.

Keita, invited by Moroccan Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali, was to have visited Morocco last December 25 but the trip was postponed because of a strike by air traffic controllers in sub-Saharan countries, the agency said.
His visit will continue until January 9.
